bank_name.description: Name of financial institution or bank

bank_address.description: Branch or headquarters address of bank

bank_phone.description: Bank telephone or customer service number

account_holder.description: Name of account holder or business entity

account_number.description: Bank account number or masked account number

account_type.description: Type of account (e.g. Checking, Savings, Current, Business, Money Market)

routing_number.description: Routing transit number, sort code, or branch code

statement_date.description: Statement generation or closing date in YYYY-MM-DD or original format

currency.description: Currency code (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR, PKR)

total_deposits.description: Total credits, deposits, or additions during period

total_withdrawals.description: Total debits, withdrawals, or subtractions during period

closing_balance.description: Ending balance at close of statement period

available_balance.description: Available funds or balance if stated

interest_earned.description: Interest paid or earned during period

transactions.description: Itemized list of transactions during the statement period

additional_fields.description: Any other key-value details, account summaries, or notes printed on statement
